comparison.objective: Level and pin-lock a see-saw platform before loading it; the candidate sets and locknuts a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Supporting an articulated platform and inserting a transverse safety pin versus concentric screw adjustment and nut counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Platform is level, pin traverses both walls and lug, blocks are placed, and the hand is untouched; candidate requires retained 90° cycling.
comparison.reason: Both include a lock, but the record tests safety-pin alignment and load sequencing rather than preserving a calibrated setting against tightening reaction.
